description: One schema-valid candidate for the pinned last-layer target. The controller in lane 5 targets this schema. Bounds are provisional until lane 4 freezes the experiment contract.

quantization.description: Adapter quantization. The siliquant_* values name Siliquant certified codebook formats; they require a siliquant_codebook_pick or certificate_payload to be present for Stage 2.

strength.description: Adapter strength (scale). Zero is excluded. One is the cap.

target_layer.description: Pinned last-layer target. No other layer is accepted.

siliquant_codebook_pick.description: Optional Siliquant codebook pick receipt (shape/certified.py output: budget, candidates, pick). Checked by shape/check_certificate.py via siliquant_bridge.verify_codebook_pick.

certificate_payload.description: Optional L2 weft FixedRadixCertificate payload, as produced by siliquant_bridge.generate_fixed_radix_certificate and consumed by FixedRadixCertificate.from_weft_dict.
